title: try_send in SSE coalescing task is the right call — defend against revert to send().await
description: The coalescing task uses try_send instead of send().await. A contributor might suggest reverting to await for 'reliability'. The await form is wrong: it holds the broadcast::Receiver across an async park, which blocks all other subscribers from receiving events while one slow client drains. In a single-user system there is only one SSE subscriber at a time, but the kith-events architecture allows multiple tabs. The try_send + drop-on-full approach is correct. The 256-deep channel means only genuinely stalled (not just slow) clients are dropped.
